utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the fifth of October. Can you all hear me? Right, let's get through this before the floor gets too noisy.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep. There's a birthday cake in the office, by the way. Quite a serious bit of cake.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's the most enthusiasm I've heard from you on a Monday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny. Brave place to leave it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's mostly held together by the dirt.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Cake and depreciating assets covered. Anything already finished we need to separate out first?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I signed off the inspection on the turbine two water valve on Tuesday. That's done, not something still waiting on me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Ah, right. I remembered the inspection, couldn't remember whether the sign-off had happened.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the air dryer yesterday. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, both closed. We're not putting either back in today's list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the palletiser was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Settled while they were still running, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Nothing outstanding from that, just passing on what was in the handover.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, context rather than another job. Right, onto what we are agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum Reid, can you take vibration readings on the Water Booster Pump today at 2pm? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, um, readings only? We're not calling that a strip-down?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Readings only. No strip-down in this one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine, I'll take the vibration readings on the Water Booster Pump today at 2pm. Fairly important, understood.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Look at that, asking before taking it apart. We're learning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I knew you'd have something to say.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you inspect the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve for leaks on Friday? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll inspect the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve for leaks on Friday. Low priority, that's clear.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you there. There's the purchase order side as well, isn't there? Separate from that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Han, can you chase the purchase order for the GT1 fuel valve this afternoon, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the GT1 fuel valve this afternoon if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, so the purchase order chase isn't being bundled into the leak inspection.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, separate things. Otherwise they end up looking like one enormous job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, the other one for you: can you run a function test on the dryer on the 3rd? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: On the 3rd, yeah? That's the date you've got against it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, on the 3rd. Keep that wording against it; low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, agreed. I'll run a function test on the dryer on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Was that me crackling, or did everyone get that?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I got a bit of robot voice, but the actual words came through.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Teams doing its Monday thing. You're clear now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum Reid, can you go to the substation to pick up the replacement parts for the main isolation valve by the end of the week? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, I'll go to the substation and pick up the replacement parts for the main isolation valve by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: End of the week for the collection, then, not fitting them?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's what I've agreed, collection only. And fairly important, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good distinction. Picking up a box and fitting what's in it aren't quite the same duration.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: While we're separating things out, I can't get to the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window confirmed. I can't tell you otherwise on this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That stays blocked, then. We're not agreeing access or adding a job for today on that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Just didn't want silence to sound like it was under way.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: What I can take is the guarding. I'll check the guarding on the IM3 tomorrow morning, and I'll make that top priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya Raman. Tomorrow morning for the IM3 guarding check, top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Tomorrow morning, top of my list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. And just to be clear, agreeing a guarding check isn't us saying there's a confirmed defect.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Let's not turn a check into a diagnosis before it's happened.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you investigate the pressure drop on the line 1 hydraulics by 11am?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the line 1 hydraulics by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Pressure drop can cover a fair few things. Wouldn't jump straight to a component.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, agreed. Investigation is what I'm taking, not promising a repair by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Investigation by 11am is the agreement.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, that all separates out properly. Finished work, blocked work, and the actual commitments. Less of a soup than usual.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's the aim. Nothing else being added off the back of the observations.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And only about ten seconds of robot voice. Strong start to the week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We finished before the cake went, potentially.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: You've got absolutely no evidence for that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Quality can't support that claim either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks, everyone. That's the stand-up done.
